municipality.effectiveLabel: Municipal-court caption branch on C-10-CRIMINAL page 1 — this route does not use it
municipality.reason: C-10-CRIMINAL offers State of Alabama and municipality caption branches. This packet selects State of Alabama and files in circuit court, so the municipality branch is outside this route.
municipality.routeConditionThatMakesItInapplicable: AL.memo.json track al-misd-conviction rules.filing: "File CR-65 Section II in the criminal division of the circuit court in the county where the charges were filed." The packet selects State of Alabama and circuit court, so the municipal caption branch is not applicable.

feeRequests.effectiveLabel: Relief this route does not seek: a court-appointed attorney (selection)
feeRequests.reason: The printed request asks the court to appoint an attorney; this expungement fee-waiver route does not seek that relief.
feeRequests.printedRequestBesideThisControl: I, because of financial hardship, am unable to hire an attorney and request that the court appoint one for me.

feeRequests.effectiveLabel: Relief this route does not seek: waiver of ignition-interlock fees (selection)
feeRequests.reason: The printed request asks to waive ignition-interlock fees; this expungement fee-waiver route does not seek that relief.
feeRequests.printedRequestBesideThisControl: I, because of financial hardship, am unable to pay for ignition interlock device fees in this case and request that these fees be waived.

feeRequests.effectiveLabel: Participant election: request waiver of the expungement-petition administrative filing fee (selection)
feeRequests.reason: This is the printed request the route concerns, but it is a sworn financial-hardship election. The packet holds no participant financial facts and leaves the election to the participant.
feeRequests.printedRequestBesideThisControl: I, because of financial hardship, am unable to pay the administrative filing fee required for filing a petition for expungement pursuant to Ala. Code 1975, § 15-27-4, and request that this fee be waived.

hardshipConditional: Complete financial affidavit and elect third expungement-fee request only when claiming hardship; if no hardship, leave all requests blank and pay. Judicial order remains empty.
priorApplicationConditional: County/case/outcome only for second previous-application branch; first branch leaves all three empty.

routeQuestionsRead.question: On what date were you convicted? Three years must have passed.
Was this a youthful offender adjudication rather than a conviction?
Have you completed all probation or parole requirements, including paying all fines, costs, restitution and other court-ordered amounts?
Is the offence on the § 12-25-32 violent offense list?
Is the offence a sex offense under § 15-20A-5?
Is the offence a crime of moral turpitude under § 17-3-30.1?
Is the offence a serious traffic offense under Article 9 of Chapter 5A of Title 32? DUI sits there.
At the time of the offence, were you operating a commercial motor vehicle or holding a CDL or CLP?
Was the crime a felony at conviction but reclassified as a misdemeanor under Act 2015-185?
routeQuestionsRead.conditionDescription: Asked on the moral-turpitude branch, where the reclassification carve-out applies.

routeQuestionsRead.question: Have you already had two expungements granted under the capped routes?

supportingDocuments.name: Certified local record — conviction and evidence of completion
supportingDocuments.obtainedFrom: The clerk of the court where the charges were filed, or the supervising agency
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Ask the clerk or supervising agency for certified evidence that all probation or parole requirements and court-ordered amounts are satisfied.

supportingDocuments.name: Certified ALEA criminal record
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Request a certified criminal record from ALEA.

selfHelpStops.condition: The prosecutor or a victim files an objection.
Whether the offence is on the § 12-25-32 violent offense list is unclear.
Whether the offence is a crime of moral turpitude under § 17-3-30.1 is unclear.
Whether the offence is a serious traffic offense under Title 32 is unclear.
Whether an Act 2015-185 reclassification applies is unclear.
Whether all court-ordered amounts including interest are satisfied is unclear.
The participant is choosing which record to spend one of the two capped expungements on.
Immigration, licensing or firearm consequences are in play.

serviceAndFiling: Circuit court in charge county; separate page7 certificate per served entity, actual service facts only, local method confirmed with clerk; no invented service or fee order.
